_README: Hand-labelled ground truth for the extraction eval (#30).
Every value here was read off the posting text by a human-equivalent pass over
tests/fixtures/postings.json, NOT copied from the extractor's output. That
distinction is the whole point: labels derived from the thing under test
measure nothing. Where the extractor disagrees with a label below, the label
is what the posting says and the extractor is wrong.
null means the posting does not state the field. It never means 'no'.
INCOMPLETE: #30 asks for at least 50 postings. This is 12. Labelling the rest
is a judgement about this job search and belongs to its owner, not to me.
CORRECTION (same session): R_1499215 and R_1499218 were first labelled from
raw text proximity, which put the wrong years against 'required'. TD posts
several levels in one requisition: '0 to 1 year' sits under 'Preferred
Qualifications:' and '3+ years relevant experience' under 'Education &
Experience:'. The required floor is the latter. The labels below were
corrected against the section headings, not against the extractor's output.

R-0000186717.note: Prose says 20 Sept; the label says 21 Sept with a 'day prior' note. Both mean the 20th.

R-0000183468.note: Single figure, not a band: 'expected salary range for the above position is $110,000'.

R-0000187520.note: '2+ years' appears under Nice-to-have, so the REQUIRED years are unstated.

R-0000187859.note: The Application Deadline label is present but carries no date.

R260025276.note: No currency token on the pay line; the band is unlabelled.

R260026119.note: 'base salary for this role is $275,000 USD'; the Salary: label itself is empty.

R_1499215.note: '0 to 1 year' is under 'Preferred Qualifications:'; the required floor is '3+ years relevant experience' under 'Education & Experience:'.

R_1499218.note: Same shape as R_1499215: '2 to 3+ years' is preferred, '5+ years relevant experience' is the required floor.
